questions.question: Describe a hardware test or repair issue you diagnosed down to the component level. What test equipment and process did you use to isolate the fault?
You have experience reading schematics and testing electronic assemblies. How would you use a schematic to develop a test procedure for a new embedded controller board?
This role involves microcontroller-based image-capture systems. What experience do you have programming electronic components or assemblies, and how did you verify the programming was successful?
Walk us through the test automation framework you developed or maintained at Zoom. What parts were implemented with Bash, batch scripts, or terminal macros?
How would you approach creating a production-ready programming and test procedure for a PCB assembly, including documentation for manufacturing technicians?
Describe your experience working with ESD-sensitive electronics and IPC J-STD-001 assembly requirements. What controls did you follow to protect boards during assembly, rework, and test?
When an electronic assembly fails environmental stress testing, how would you investigate whether the root cause is a component, solder joint, layout-related issue, or firmware/programming problem?
This position uses C for embedded firmware development. What C programming experience do you have, and how would you build on your scripting and automation background to work with embedded C?

What is your familiarity with PCB schematic-capture or layout tools such as PADs, Altium, or DX Designer? If you have not used those tools directly, how have you used schematics and board documentation in your prior work?
Describe a time you led scheduling, training, or process improvements for a hardware test team. How did you track work, maintain procedure quality, and ensure deadlines were met?
